messages:
Emma (Docs): quick ping  I opened a small PR to tighten the Dedicated provisioning quickstart: add a minimal YAML, CLI, and Python/TS snippets, and clarify eviction/isolation wording. Can someone sanity-check? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1650 :wave:
Kai (Runtime): thumbs up on doing this. couple of runtime notes: use the term `eviction` (not preemption). accepted eviction_policy values: graceful | immediate | delayed. eviction_priority: low|medium|high (lower = evict later). delayed triggers a cooldown (default: 300s). we also support isolation_level: tenant|node|gpu.
Emma (Docs): thanks Kai. current YAML in PR is:
```yaml
name: gpu-quickstart
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 6
eviction_policy: graceful
eviction_priority: low
isolation_level: node
```
Jon (CLI): quick nit: CLI flags are kebab-case. example should be `--eviction-priority` and `--isolation-level`. Also prefer `--min-instances` (with hyphen). Draft CLI in PR currently uses underscores.
Emma (Docs): noted  I'll update. Draft CLI I'll push:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated create-pool \
  --name gpu-quickstart \
  --min-instances 2 \
  --max-instances 6 \
  --eviction-priority low \
  --isolation-level node
```
Priya (Product): SLA/billing wording: keep it short and link out. Suggest: "Reserved: baseline guaranteed per contract. Burst: best-effort; subject to pool & regional availability." and one-line billing note: "Burst billed at on-demand rates; reserved billed under commitment." Link to SLA/pricing pages.
Emma (Docs): good, will use Priya's lines and add links. redwood-docs-bot: CI link check: `handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools.md` -> 404. Suggest `/handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools-guide.md` instead.
Emma (Docs): thanks bot 44D I'll update links to the guide path.
Kai (Runtime): one more flowchart nuance: fallback to hosted should be described as routing-policy-driven and tenant opt-in controlled. Add callout: "Fallback to hosted only after sustained SLO violation per routing policy; Private customers may opt out."
Emma (Docs): adding that callout and alt text for the flowchart for accessibility. Also adding tiny Python + TS SDK snippets for parity:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.dedicated.create_pool(name="gpu-quickstart", min_instances=2, max_instances=6, eviction_policy="graceful")
```
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from "@redwoodai/sdk"
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
await client.dedicated.createPool({ name: "gpu-quickstart", minInstances: 2, maxInstances: 6, evictionPolicy: "graceful" })
```
Jon (CLI): LGTM once flags are kebab-case. I'll run the smoke tests after you push.
Priya (Product): I'll give a quick read for SLA wording after your update. If legal needs changes we'll follow up.
Emma (Docs): thanks all 64F pushing updates now (kebab flags, SLA/billing lines, link fixes, callout, SDK snippets, alt text). Please drop one short review so I can merge today.
redwood-docs-bot: CI check queued: will report back if any broken links remain.
